props.name: children
props.description: The text. It stays selectable and searchable.

props.name: colors
props.description: Two or more colours. They are repeated to make the loop seamless.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one pass. Ignored when `animate` is false.

props.name: angle
props.description: Angle of the sweep in degrees.

props.name: glow
props.description: A soft coloured halo under the text, for a dark or busy background.
